responsibility: Declares a small runtime support API for tracking opaque pointers or addresses in grouped sets keyed by CARDINAL values. It introduces the abstract Group type and operations to create and destroy a group, test membership, and associate, retrieve, or delete per-address keys; this interface is used by other runtime modules such as Storage and RTdata to maintain allocation or object ownership metadata independently of the higher-level ISO library APIs.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the abstract interface half of the RTentity pair, exposing Group and the key-association operations without revealing storage details; RTentity.mod is the companion implementation that realizes those operations with a binary tree, libc allocation, and RTco locking.
